title: Kamishiro Rui — To The Undersea Show!〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Morinomiya Music Academy

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Next, we have our ballet lesson...!
The classroom for that is this way, yes?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I think we're finally getting used to the sheer size of this school.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes!
That also goes for our lessons.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Right. They've all been difficult, but we're starting to keep up well with the others. I believe that's evidence of us growing.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Also...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I'd have nothing more to say if only we'd found a way to become more flexible for our ballet lessons...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I know exactly what you're thinking about right now...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, our minds must be communing.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: To be fair, we're both struggling with the same thing...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, it's a tough problem to solve.
A part of me wishes that I were a mollusk...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Like a squid...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: An octopus or sea slug would also do.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: A jellyfish would as well, no?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Actually, they're cnidarians, not mollusks.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <We came over to see how things have been going over with their new training venue...>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <But they just said that they wanted to become squids and octopuses or something, didn't they?>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Wh-What happened to them?!>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <I don't know...>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <But based on the way they were behaving, something is definitely bothering them...>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<What do we do...?
I want Tsukasa and Rui to smile again...>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Wait! I know☆>
bgm_area00004
A few days later
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hmm... It looks like Nene and Emu haven't arrived yet.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Things may be taking a little longer than usual on their ends.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Right.
Then, in the meantime, why don't we practice a little?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
That sounds good.
We can go over what we covered during today's lessons and...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What's wrong, Rui?

rows.Speaker: Miku's Voice
rows.Line: Tsukasa, Ruiii!!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Whoa! G-Got you!!

rows.Speaker: Miku & Len
rows.Line: Thanks☆

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Nice catch, Tsukasa. Your reflexes are truly superb.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Wait, you knew they were coming...
Why didn't you tell me sooner...?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Anyway, what's going on?
Neither of you are wearing your usual outfits...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Hehe. You noticed?
I'm dressed as a fish today!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And I'm a squid☆

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: A fish and a squid...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yup☆ We're here to invite you guys to come see a show under the sea!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: “The sea is full of so many fun and wonderful things! Like now! It's time to dance!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Wow...!
This show's more intricate than I thought it'd be.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, they've done an excellent job with the lights. It really feels like we're underwater.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Tsukasa! Rui!
We even have costumes for you guys to wear! You can be an octopus, a jellyfish...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? Does this mean we get to be a part of the show?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah! Don't be afraid to pick the... Uh, sea slug, either!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
(An octopus, a squid, a jellyfish and even a sea slug...
I thought it was all a big coincidence at first, but...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Now I see...
Then, Tsukasa, why don't we join them?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes! I still don't quite know what's going on, but this looks like fun! Watch as I perform the most elegant octopus dance you've ever seen!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Did you two enjoy the show?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Did it help to dance around as an octopus and stuff...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, the show itself was wonderful.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But this is all a big misunderstanding. Please allow me to take this opportunity to clear things up.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: A big misunderstanding?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. I believe Miku and the others here overheard our conversation about us turning into a squid and octopus. That's why you all put on this show for us, yes?

rows.Speaker: Miku, Tsukasa, MEIKO & Len
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: So, that conversation was about...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
What?!
Then, that means we all got the wrong idea!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: We got the impression that you two were being bothered by something you couldn't tell us about.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: So, you guys didn't actually want to turn into a squid and octopus...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: My apologies, everyone. It seems we've made you all worry about us.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But it was fun to dance around as an octopus and jellyfish!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Really?! Thank goodness!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, my body felt much more flexible than usual for some reason.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I also felt like I was able to move like a piece of jelly! Could that be because we were playing squishy animals...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. I have to think it's because you've both been working so hard to become more flexible!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Our hard work seems to have paid off in a curious way, Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Indeed! It's a testament to the value of working hard each day!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehehe.
Why don't we try doing a few more advanced stretches before our next lesson?
